# InputGroup

Adds an icon, button or text addon to an Input: search icon, copy button, unit (GiB), prefix (https://).

`KenosUI.InputGroup` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.InputGroup>…</KenosUI.InputGroup>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.InputGroup">…</x-import>
```

## Props (InputGroupProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `startElement` | `IconName \| React.ReactNode` | Icon name or node inside the input, left. |
| `endElement` | `IconName \| React.ReactNode` | Icon name or node (e.g. CopyButton) inside the input, right. |
| `startAddon` | `React.ReactNode` | Text box attached left / right, e.g. "https://", "GiB". |
| `endAddon` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` | One Input. |
